item.title: Markdown Tips and Tricks
item.description: Learn useful Markdown formatting techniques for your blog posts.
item.content:encoded:
Hwaro uses Markdown for content. Here are some useful formatting tips.

Text Formatting

  • Bold text using **bold**
  • Italic text using *italic*
  • Inline code using backticks

Code Blocks

Use triple backticks for code blocks:

puts "Hello from Crystal!"

Lists

Ordered lists:

  1. First item
  2. Second item
  3. Third item

Unordered lists:

  • Item one
  • Item two
  • Item three

Links and Images

Create a link with square brackets around the text and parentheses around the URL, for example Hwaro on GitHub. Prefix the same form with ! to embed an image instead.

Tables

Syntax Renders as
**bold** bold
*italic* italic
` code ` code

Blockquotes

This is a blockquote. It can span multiple lines.

Happy writing!
